requiredBehavior: Provide an owned common entry for the floating/disclosure/menu presentation behavior used by this changed scope. Call sites describe content/semantics and configuration rather than duplicating per-panel construction, listeners or CSS.

Share applicable open/close/toggle, stacking, cleanup and safe focus-return behavior. Keep fixed modal, movable window and anchored function menu semantics explicit; do not give nonmodal controls a modal focus trap or remove modal safeguards for reuse.

Anchored function surfaces share positioning, start/end alignment, viewport bounds and resize/reposition logic. Left/right placement is configuration of this positioning behavior, not separate implementations by location.

Reuse current button/menu/select/field primitive styles and relevant existing public presentation seams. Needed variants have real semantic reason. No copied Legacy accumulated selectors/DOM/event/render code.

Exercise multiple current consumers to prove shared behavior and independent lifetime/identity. Prevent shared handler leaks, stale callbacks or accidental closing/opening of unrelated instance. Preserve draft/IME/gesture and command authority.

Scope this repair to its actual new/changed status/output/debug/menu consumers and affected existing common pieces. Use this principle as standing direction for future authorized workspace work; do not expand into unrelated whole-app or third-party reflection framework.
implementationNote: Exact module/API organization is an engineering choice for original Implementer under existing extension/mount/command contracts. Maximum practical reuse and one public entry do not imply centralizing canonical Graph state or bypassing owning features.
reviewRequirement: Fresh Reviewer checks actual shared entry/positioning reuse and independent instance cleanup, besides behavioral UI tests. Screenshot similarity alone is insufficient.
